keyLDLDesc: Inotakura cholesterol kuenda mutsinga dzeropa. LDL yakakwirira inogona kukonzera kuvharika kwetsinga uye chirwere chemoyo.
keyHDLDesc: Inobatsira kubvisa cholesterol yakawandisa muropa. Mazinga epamusoro eHDL anodzivirira moyo.
keyTCHDLDesc: Inoratidza kuenzanisa pakati pecholesterol yese neakanaka. Chiyero chakaderera chinoratidza hutano hwakanaka hwemoyo.
keyNonHDLDesc: Inosanganisira mhando dzese dzine ngozi dzecholesterol (TC minus HDL). Chiratidzo chakasimba chenjodzi yemoyo.
keyUreaDesc: Chinhu chinoraswa chinogadzirwa pakupwanyika kwemapuroteni. Mazinga akakwirira anogona kuratidza kushomeka kwemvura kana dambudziko remitsvo.
keyCreatinineDesc: Chinhu chinoraswa chinobva pakushanda kwemhasuru. Chinoshandiswa kuongorora kushanda kwemitsvo.
keyUricAcidDesc: Inogadzirwa pakupwanyika kwemapurine muzvokudya. Mazinga akakwirira anogona kukonzera gout kana matombo emitsvo.

keyDisclaimerPoint4: Tora matanho anodiwa kana uine allergies kana kusanzwa zvakanaka.
keyDisclaimerPoint5: Zvishandiso zvekuongorora paIndaneti hazvisi zvekutsvaga chirwere; mhedzisiro inofanira kukurukurwa nemushandi wehutano.

Migumisiro inonyorwa zvichienderana nemuyero wemetric, uko 6/6 inomiririra kuona kwakajairwa uye manhamba epasi akakura (kusvika 6/60) anoratidza kuderera kwekujeka kwekuona kure.

Lean body mass yakakwira inowanzoratidza simba remhasuru riri nani, metabolism yakanaka uye hutano hwemuviri hwese, nepo yakaderera inogona kukanganisa simba, kufamba uye hutano hwenguva refu.
